CXAction.doc: An abstract class that declares a programmatic interface for objects that represent a telephony action.

CXAnswerCallAction.doc: An encapsulation of the act of answering an incoming call.

CXCallAction.doc: A programmatic interface for objects that represent a telephony action associated with a call object.

CXCallController.doc: A programmatic interface for interacting with and observing calls.

CXCallDirectoryExtensionContext.doc: A programmatic interface for adding identification and blocking entries to a Call Directory app extension.

CXCallDirectoryManager.doc: The programmatic interface to an object that manages a Call Directory app extension.

CXCallDirectoryProvider.doc: The principal object for a Call Directory app extension for a host app.

CXCallObserver.doc: A programmatic interface for an object that manages a list of active calls and observes call changes.

CXCallUpdate.doc: An encapsulation of new and changed information about a call.

CXEndCallAction.doc: An encapsulation of the act of ending a call.

CXHandle.doc: A way to reach a call recipient, such as a phone number or email address.

CXPlayDTMFCallAction.doc: An encapsulation of the act of playing a dual tone multifrequency (DTMF) sequence.

CXProvider.doc: An object that represents a telephony provider.

CXProviderConfiguration.doc: An encapsulation of the configuration of a provider object.

CXSetGroupCallAction.doc: An encapsulation of the act of grouping or ungrouping calls.

CXSetHeldCallAction.doc: An encapsulation of the act of placing a call on hold or removing a call from hold.

CXSetMutedCallAction.doc: An encapsulation of the act of muting or unmuting a call.

CXStartCallAction.doc: An encapsulation of the act of initiating an outgoing call.

CXTransaction.doc: An object that contains zero or more action objects for a call controller to perform.

CXCallDirectoryExtensionContextDelegate.doc: A collection of methods a Call Directory extension context object calls when a request fails.

CXCallObserverDelegate.doc: A collection of methods the system calls when a call changes state.

CXProviderDelegate.doc: A collection of methods that a telephony provider object calls.

CXCallDirectoryEnabledStatus.doc: The enabled status of a Call Directory app extension, as reported by the getEnabledStatusForExtension(withIdentifier:completionHandler:) method.

CXCallEndedReason.doc: The reason that a call ended.

CXCallEndedReasonFailed.doc: An error occurred while attempting to service the call.

CXCallEndedReasonRemoteEnded.doc: The remote party explicitly ended the call.

CXCallEndedReasonUnanswered.doc: The call never started connecting and was never explicitly ended, such as when an outgoing or incoming call times out.

CXErrorCode.doc: Error codes for the CallKit errors.

CXErrorCodeCallDirectoryManagerError.doc: Errors when interacting with a call directory manager.

CXErrorCodeIncomingCallError.doc: Codes for errors that occur during incoming calls.

CXErrorCodeNotificationServiceExtensionE.doc: Errors that can occur when reporting new, incoming VoIP calls.

CXPlayDTMFCallActionType.doc: The types of events that generate dial tones.

-fail.doc: Reports the failed execution of the action.

-fulfill.doc: Reports the successful execution of the action.

-initWithCoder:.doc: Creates a new telephony action with data in an unarchiver.

-fulfillWithDateConnected:.doc: Reports the successful execution of the action at the specified time.

-isEqualToCall:.doc: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether a given call is equal to the receiver.

-initWithCallUUID:.doc: Initializes a new action for a call identified by a given UUID.

-initWithCoder:.doc: Creates a new action for a call with data in an unarchiver.

-init.doc: Initializes a new call controller with a private, serial queue, which is used for calling completion blocks.

-initWithQueue:.doc: Initializes a new call controller with a specified queue, which is used for calling completion blocks.

-requestTransaction:completion:.doc: Requests that the actions in the specified transaction be asynchronously performed by the telephony provider.

-requestTransactionWithAction:completion.doc: Requests that the transaction that contains the specified action be asynchronously performed by the telephony provider.

-requestTransactionWithActions:completio.doc: Requests that the transaction that contains the specified actions be asynchronously performed by the telephony provider.

-addBlockingEntryWithNextSequentialPhone.doc: Adds a blocking entry with the specified phone number.

-addIdentificationEntryWithNextSequentia.doc: Adds an identification entry with the specified phone number and label.

-completeRequestWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Completes the request to the extension context.

-removeBlockingEntryWithPhoneNumber:.doc: Removes a blocking entry that contains the specified phone number.

-removeIdentificationEntryWithPhoneNumbe.doc: Removes an identification entry that contains the specified phone number.

-getEnabledStatusForExtensionWithIdentif.doc: Asynchronously returns the enabled status of the extension with the specified identifier.

-openSettingsWithCompletionHandler:.doc: Opens the iOS Settings app and shows the Call Blocking & Identification settings.

-reloadExtensionWithIdentifier:completio.doc: Asynchronously reloads the extension with the specified identifier.

-beginRequestWithExtensionContext:.doc: Tells the extension to prepare for a host app’s request.

-setDelegate:queue:.doc: Sets a call observer delegate, specifying an optional queue on which to execute delegate methods.

-fulfillWithDateEnded:.doc: Reports the successful execution of the action at the specified time.

-initWithType:value:.doc: Initializes a new handle of a given type with the specified value.

-isEqualToHandle:.doc: Returns a Boolean value that indicates whether a given handle is equal to the receiver.

-initWithCallUUID:digits:type:.doc: Initializes a new action for a call identified by a given UUID, as well as a specified type and sequence of digits.

-initWithCoder:.doc: Creates a new action to play dual-tone multifrequency (DTMF) tones with data in an unarchiver.

+reportNewIncomingVoIPPushPayload:comple.doc: Reports a new incoming call after your notification service extension decrypts a VoIP call request.

-initWithConfiguration:.doc: Initializes a new provider with the specified configuration.

-invalidate.doc: Invalidates the provider and completes all active calls with an error.

-pendingCallActionsOfClass:withCallUUID:.doc: Returns all call actions in any pending transactions of the specified class for the specified call identifier that are incomplete.

-reportCallWithUUID:endedAtDate:reason:.doc: Reports to the provider that a call with the specified identifier ended at a given date for a particular reason.

-reportCallWithUUID:updated:.doc: Reports to the provider that an active call updated its information.

-reportNewIncomingCallWithUUID:update:co.doc: Reports a new incoming call with the specified unique identifier to the provider.

-reportOutgoingCallWithUUID:connectedAtD.doc: Reports to the provider that an outgoing call with the specified unique identifier finished connecting at a particular time.

-reportOutgoingCallWithUUID:startedConne.doc: Reports to the provider that an outgoing call with the specified unique identifier started connecting at a particular time.

-setDelegate:queue:.doc: Sets a provider delegate, specifying an optional queue on which to execute delegate methods.

-init.doc: Creates the configuration of a provider object.

-initWithLocalizedName:.doc: Initializes a configuration with the specified localized name.

-initWithCallUUID:callUUIDToGroupWith:.doc: Initializes a new action for a call identified by a given UUID, as well as a call to group with identified by another UUID.

-initWithCoder:.doc: Creates a new action to group calls with data in an unarchiver.

-initWithCallUUID:onHold:.doc: Initializes a new action for a call identified by a given UUID, as well as whether the call is on hold.

-initWithCoder:.doc: Creates a new action to place a call on hold with data in an unarchiver.

-initWithCallUUID:muted:.doc: Initializes a new action for a call identified by a given UUID, as well as whether the call is muted.

-initWithCoder:.doc: Creates a new action for a call with data in an unarchiver.

-fulfillWithDateStarted:.doc: Reports the successful execution of the action at the specified time.

-initWithCallUUID:handle:.doc: Initializes a new action to start a call with the specified UUID to a recipient with the specified handle.

-initWithCoder:.doc: Creates a new action to start a call with data in an unarchiver.

-addAction:.doc: Adds the specified action to the transaction.

-initWithAction:.doc: Initializes a new transaction with the specified action.

-initWithActions:.doc: Initializes a new transaction with the specified actions.

UUID.doc: The unique identifier for the action.

complete.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the action has been performed by the provider.

timeoutDate.doc: The time after which the action cannot be completed.

UUID.doc: The unique identifier for the call.

hasConnected.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the call has connected.

hasEnded.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the call has ended.

onHold.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the call is on hold.

outgoing.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the call is outgoing.

callUUID.doc: The unique identifier for the call associated with the action.

callObserver.doc: Returns an observer for active calls.

delegate.doc: Sets a delegate that can handle request failures for the Call Directory extension context object.

incremental.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the request provides data incrementally.

CXCallDirectoryEnabledStatus.doc: The enabled status of a Call Directory app extension, as reported by the getEnabledStatusForExtensionWithIdentifier:completionHandler: method.

sharedInstance.doc: Returns the shared call directory manager instance for the app.

calls.doc: Returns the active calls of the telephony provider.

hasVideo.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the call includes video in addition to audio.

localizedCallerName.doc: The localized name of the caller.

remoteHandle.doc: The handle for the remote party (for an incoming call, this is the caller; for an outgoing call, this is the callee).

supportsDTMF.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the call can send DTMF (dual tone multifrequency) tones via hard pause digits or in-call keypad entries.

supportsGrouping.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the call can be grouped with other calls.

supportsHolding.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the call can be placed on hold or removed from hold.

supportsUngrouping.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the call can be ungrouped from other calls.

CXPlayDTMFCallActionType.doc: The types of events that generate dial tones.

digits.doc: The digits tapped by the user into the in-call keypad or included in the dial string.

type.doc: The type of the call action.

iconTemplateImageData.doc: The PNG data for the icon image to be displayed for the provider.

includesCallsInRecents.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the provider includes a call in the system’s Recents list after the call ends.

localizedName.doc: The localized name of the provider.

maximumCallGroups.doc: The maximum number of call groups.

maximumCallsPerCallGroup.doc: The maximum number of calls per call group.

ringtoneSound.doc: The name of the sound resource in the app bundle to be used for the provider ringtone.

supportsVideo.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the provider supports video in addition to audio.

callUUIDToGroupWith.doc: The unique identifier of the call to be grouped with the call associated with the receiver.

onHold.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the call is placed on hold.

muted.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the call is muted.

contactIdentifier.doc: The identifier for the call recipient.

handle.doc: The handle of the call recipient.

video.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the call is a video call.

UUID.doc: The unique identifier of the transaction.

actions.doc: The actions added to a transaction.

complete.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the transaction has been completed.
